notes.title: 2025 Roadmap Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/fb057cb5873ced596436f9b20bf2146da7074dac.png[/img]

Hey there, Project Winter Community! Sam here, Sr. Producer for Project Winter 👋 

As most of you know, we released a community survey back in January. We received over 1000 responses in both English and Chinese. From the bottom of my heart, I'd like to thank everyone for taking the time to answer our questions and provide us with your thoughts. We have taken the last ~2 months to aggregate, translate, and sort through all the responses, and have made some decisions regarding the future of Project Winter, specifically our plans for 2025. 

We would like to make sure that all new and existing players know - and truly [i]feel [/i]- that we, as Developers, are committed to making sure Project Winter continues to live and thrive. As a result of this endeavor, I have a 2025 roadmap that we'd like to share with everyone. We are calling this our "Road to Project Winter v2.0". I want to be crystal-clear that this is not a sequel to Project Winter, but rather, a refreshed Project Winter experience. 

We will not be releasing specifics about any of the items on the roadmap - we want to surprise you with each content update / release - [i]but [/i]we do want to show you what we're working on! 

We are planning the following changes to be released this year:
[list]
[*] We will release at least 2 new maps
[*] Lobby hosts will be able to select what map to play next
[*] Gondola map is coming back to Normal mode!
[*] We are removing both the Ally role and Wild Spirit (ghost bear) from Normal modes
[*] We will be releasing something we are code-naming "Cabin Fever" (no details about this will be announced, so don't ask 
[/list]

In addition to all of the above changes, we will also be making a ton of balancing changes to in-game messaging, items, inventory management, player block function, the Store, and the HUD/UI. We will also be adding a new throwing mechanic! 

We are very excited for what the year has in store for us and for the community, and we hope you will love everything when it is released!

notes.title: Wilderness Wardrobe Update
notes.notes:
The Wilderness Wardrobe Update Is Now Live!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/4e98d7dc5067bc2237479163f3b0583ea500c246.png[/img]
We’re excited to announce that our latest update is now live! This release focuses on refining your gameplay experience with a range of quality-of-life changes, bug fixes, and some key balancing adjustments.

[b]Welcome New Players! [/b]
A warm welcome to all our new players who’ve recently joined the community! We’re thrilled to have you on board. Demo mode is now back online, so if you’re looking to explore the game with friends, it’s a great (and free) way to get a feel for everything we have to offer.

[b]Balancing & Improvements[/b]

[b]Abandoned Ranger[/b]
[list]
[*] The Abandoned Ranger objective has now been added to Normal games. Previously, this was only available in Custom games.
[*] We’ve rebalanced the sabotaging mechanics. Signal Boosters that have been sabotaged will now require players to gather a small number of resources to repair them.
[/list]
[b]Wild Spirit[/b]
[list]
[*] To prevent exploits, the Wild Spirit ability can no longer be used immediately in front of entrances or buildings. However, be aware that a transformed bear might still block these entrances!
[*] Traitor Items
[/list]
[b]Traitor Crates[/b]
[list]
[*] The spawn rate of energy drinks in Traitor Crates has been increased.
[/list]
[b]Objectives & Armory[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve increased the difficulty of the Smoke Signal, Repair, and Stockpile objectives.
[*] The probability of different items, including guns, spawning in armory crates has also been adjusted.
[*] Cosmetics
[/list]

[b]Cosmetics[/b]
[list]
[*] New cosmetics are now available in-store for September, along with additions to our permanent Store collection.
[/list]

[b]Notable Bug Fixes [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed various issues with snowshoes, ensuring they are consumed correctly and updating their description to reflect that they leave no snow trail. 
[*] Corrected an issue where Traitors were unable to open bunkers with Traitor Credits. 
[*] The Ally role description has been updated to correctly state that the Ally Player can take on multiple roles, not just survivor. 
[*] Corrected the sickle skin's range, ensuring it matches the default sickle. 
[/list]
Full Update Notes ➞ https://projectwinter.co/updates/

Attention Survivors!

Where is Gondolo?

This update removes the Gondola map from the Normal mode rotation, replacing it with a new "Beach" map.

We've also reworked multiple game mechanics: 
- Traitor Airdrops now drop on the completion of objectives
- The Dig Site objective now has its pieces carried like batteries.

On top of that we're adding a new Traitor item called "Global Mute", which temporarily mutes all communication.

Install the latest update (available on all platforms) to try out these new changes!


[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]NEW FEATURES & GENERAL CHANGES:[/b][/h3]

[b]New “Beach” Map[/b]
[list][*]A new map has been added to the game.
[*]This new map is largely the same as Gondola, but without actually having a Gondola.
[*]This map is only available in Normal game modes.[/list]

[b]Traitor Airdrops Rework[/b]
[list][*]Traitor Airdrops no longer act as rewards for stalling objective progress.
[*]Traitor Airdrops are now dropped upon objective completion:
[*]1 Traitor Airdrop is awarded for the completion of First Objective.
[*]1 Traitor Airdrop is awarded for the completion of Second Objective.[/list]

[b]DigSite Objective Rework[/b]
[list]
[*] Dig site objects are now carried like batteries rather than held in a player's inventory.
[/list]

[b]New Traitor Item[/b]
[list]
[*] “Global Mute” has been added as a new Traitor item.
[*] Similar to the “Jam Radio” item, this item temporarily mutes all communication.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]BALANCE CHANGES:[/b][/h3]

[b]Traitor Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased spawn rate of level 1 energy drinks in low-risk traitor crates.
[*] Increased crafting cost of Solar Pulse traitor item from 10 Traitor Credits to 12.
[*] Separated Traitor Airdrops into different loot tables
[*] 1st Airdrop contains less offensive items, and more traps and deceptive utilities
[*] 2nd Airdrop contains more power-shifting, offensive items.
[/list]

[b]General Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]  Adjusted spawn rates for first objective animal waves in Blackout.
[*] This should decrease the difficulty of this objective.
[*] Decreased the amount of resources that spawn in the South West tile in Blackout
[*] The Gondola map is removed from Normal Mode’s map rotation.
[*]  Gondola is still available for play in custom games.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]BUG FIXES:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved start up flow if network connectivity is unavailable at start up
[*] Fixed incorrect air drops being sent when completing certain objectives in Blackout mode.
[*] Fixed players being unaffected by jamming on blue and yellow radios if they had a red radio equipped at the moment jamming took effect.
[*] Traitor-only items now appear at the bottom of the crafting menu.
[*] Fixed a translation issue for the word “Back” in Ukrainian.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]KNOWN ISSUES:[/b][/h3]

[*] The Immune role is mistranslated in Canadian French.
[*] Many supported languages are not updated for the new Yeti and Hunter descriptions.

[*] The words "Emote Menu" appear instead of a prompt to assign a keybind in the keyboard keybinds settings.

[*] Players resurrected by a Necromancer while in a herb bush will become permanently slowed.
[*] The "Survive without placing any traps" bonus objective does not fail if an Icebomb is used to trap an objective.
[*] Incorrect Tracker Tag color is displayed if a player swaps clothes with a player who was tagged with a green tag. 
[*] Players using their DLC trial cannot access the timeline after their game.
[/list]

Stay warm Survivors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/0c6b19c2836be7cc15d47b401474c235b154c1d1.png[/img]

A new update is here and it’s the first of two that will introduce new strategies and ways to play the game. 

The balance of “power” is shifting as we move to introduce more ways to focus on the social deception and roleplay aspects of the game. 

The biggest addition in this update are four new items: Disguise Kit, Snow Shoes, Ice Bomb and Sound Emitter. 

Short Teaser: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hCJC4eNCXn0
Long Teaser: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=37EyHfVWyK0﻿

In addition to this update, we’re proud to announce that Project Winter has hit a milestone of 2.5 M users across all platforms! 

We want to thank everyone who has supported us as we continue to update and provide new content for our community. 

Starting today Project Winter will have a permanent price drop. Spread the news and invite your friends for the optimal backstabbing experience! 

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]NEW FEATURES & GENERAL CHANGES:[/b][/h3]

[b]NEW ITEMS[/b]

[b]1. Disguise Kit[/b]
[list][*] A single-use item that functions similarly to the “Swap Clothes” mechanic. This item allows players to disguise themselves as another player regardless of their status as living or dead. The disguise lasts for a limited amount of time, and consumes the kit when used. This item can be crafted at the Crafting Table.
[*] This item provides opportunities for Traitors (or cheeky survivors) to shift the blame to other players while commiting traitorous acts. This item doubles as a source of security of being caught sabotaging or killing others, as players will not see the actual clothing of the person committing the crime.[/list]
[b]2. Snow Shoes[/b]
[list][*] A single-use item that removes their snow trail and footstep audio. These effects last for a short amount of time before wearing off. This item can be crafted by Traitors at the Crafting Table.
[*] This item opens up more stealth strategies for traitors. Allowing traitors to sneak into objectives and steal parts without a trail, and making quick getaways if they’re caught.[/list]
[b]3. Ice Bomb[/b]
[list][*] A single-use item similar to the Smoke Bomb that creates a cloud of icey smoke upon use. When activated, the icey smoke will cause players to lose warmth rapidly when standing in Ice Bomb’s radius. It can be used from the hand, as a trap, or thrown. This item can be crafted at the Crafting Table.
[*] The Ice Bomb offers a unique opportunity that many other items do not. It provides Traitors a way to prevent survivors from entering an area, or deterring them from attacking for an extended amount of time, where traditional traps are removed after activation.[/list]
[b]4. Sound Emitter[/b]
[list][*] A single-use item that emits audio clips over a short amount of time before the item self-destructs. This item is placed like a trap, and will play suspicious audio cues that players can hear from quite a distance.
[*] This item aims to provide a way for Traitors to distract or lure survivors away from their current objective and either sidetrack or Ambush.[/list]

Stabby Holidays Survivors!

'Tis the season for Treason! You will notice the cabin has some holiday cheer sprinkled over it - brought to you by the Project Winter elves! 

This update is filled with a bunch of presents that we’re excited to share with you! We’ve added an in-game friends list, traitor ability items, and additions to custom modes including custom Blackout! Plus some other extra goodies and bug fixes! 

Our Holiday event will also be extra special this year - stay tuned for more info when it starts on December 20th!

[i]PS. We know you’ve heard of Christmas in July… but have you heard of Summer in December? Our new store items will have you feelin’ sun-sational in the Project Winter Wonderland this holiday season! Available at approximately 3:00PM EST[/i]

[h3][b]NEW FEATURES & GENERAL CHANGES:[/b][/h3]

[b]An in-game friends list is now available.[/b]
[list][*] Players can send friend requests to or block players they’ve recently played with.
[*] Players can send game invites to their friends.
[*] Players you have blocked cannot join lobbies you host.
[*] If someone you’ve blocked joins a lobby that you’re in (and aren’t hosting), they are automatically muted. [/list]
[b]Traitor airdrop abilities have been changed to items.[/b]
[list][*] Two of these items are available in every traitor airdrop.
[*] Traitors can also craft these items using traitor credits at the cabin crafting table.
[*] In addition to the original Radio Jammer, Second Objective Locator, Remote Sabotager, and Global Exile Remote items, two new craftable traitor items have been added:
[*] Solar Pulse, which causes a Solar Flare event.
[*] Hysterical Gas, which causes a Mass Hysteria event.
[*] The Remote Sabotager always sabotages the first objective.[/list]
[b]New options have been added to custom games.[/b]
[list][*] Past roles Soldier, Medic, Scientist, Innocent, Traitor Medic, Traitor Scientist, Traitor Hacker, and Saboteur have been added as role options.
[*] An option has been added to disable purchasing items from crates with traitor credits.
[*] An option has been added to disable the Hackers being able to hack the truth serum lab.
[*] An option has been added to disable all visible player names at the start of a match.
[*] An option has been added to allow disabling ghost abilities, including the ability for ghosts to pick up and put down items.
[*] An option has been added that causes possible second objective locations to show have beacons to all players similar to the first objective beacon.
[*] Players can more easily see the settings of a custom game lobby without joining it.
[*] An abbreviated list of settings is visible on the left side of the lobby list.
[*] Players can press the “Custom Settings” button on a lobby’s list entry to see all the settings [/list]
[b]Players can now create custom Blackout games.[/b]
[list][*] All options available in standard custom games are available in custom Blackout games, except for map and first objective selection.
[*] Two presets are available by default for custom Blackout matches, the Monster Mishmash and Whispers in the Wind. [/list]

Hello Survivors!

Today we present you with a housekeeping update!

Tired of trying to find poison around the map? Fret no more! Poison is now craftable with 1 fuel and 1 herb! You can now also craft a new item - poisoned first-aid kits! Be careful though as the traitors will have access to this as well…

With the addition of more customizability options within our custom game mode during the last update, we only saw fit to add in the option for saved game presets! Pick from recommended presets uploaded by the devs or save your favourite match settings to play again later!

We’re excited to see what custom presets you all create and the mayhem that will surely ensue!

Please note that we are in the process of overhauling how we load the game. This should give us better performance in loading times, but may result in some unforeseen bugs.  If you notice something please contact us through our [url=discord.gg/projectwinter]Discord[/url] in the #report-bugs channel.

[h3][b]NEW FEATURES & GENERAL CHANGES:[/b][/h3]

Custom game settings changes:
[list][*] Added setting to control the first and second objective types
[*] Added setting to cause game to end when all traitors have died
[*] Added setting to control the difficulty of the repair and animal wave objective types
[*] Added setting to control the rate at which traitors gain credits from being near survivors
[*] Presets: players can now save their settings as presets via a new tab on the custom game settings screen. Up to 10 presets can be stored, and players can also choose from a selection of recommended presets that have their settings locked, giving players joining from the lobby browser an easy way to see what kind of custom game they’re joining.[/list]
Various changes to the poisoning mechanic:

[*] Poisoned first-aid kits can be crafted with 1 first-aid kit and 1 poison
[*] All forms of poison except the poison crossbow now reduce all stats by 10% when applied
[*] Reduced duration from poisoned foods and interactables from 60 to 30 secs
[*] Hunger loss from poison now happens each time player vomits, rather than immediately[/list]
[list][*] Herb bushes no longer have collision, will instead slow the player while they’re moving through them
[*] All regular bunkers will now have one console only when playing a solo custom match so they can be opened more easily
[*] Added a new info box to custom game lobbies that will indicate whether players will be eligible to earn progress in achievements, unlock tasks, etc. (if there are at least 5 players and a minimum of 1 traitor or more in the custom settings)
[*] Updated terminology for sabotage actions: “break” is now used for actions that will permanently affect the sabotaged object for the rest of the match, while “sabotage” indicates a temporary effect

[*] Player downed timer will now pause while mass hysteria event transition is active

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747333/30579203fd0ca41ad3b0ff78461db526b603f4c4.png[/img]

Hello Survivors!

Today we have some exciting news. A new game mode! We are introducing a [u][b]Basic Mode[/b][/u] for new players learning the game and for seasoned players who want more simplified gameplay. The mode will include shorter rounds, a smaller map, a simplified ruleset, and no additional roles. 

For those who like to spice things up, we also added more to the custom game mode! Enjoy a wealth of choices for how you want to enjoy your Project Winter experience. Have less than 5 players, control escape vehicle capacities, timer limits, a larger range for the number of traitors in the game, and so much more! 

[h3][b]NEW FEATURES & GENERAL CHANGES[/b][/h3]
[b]Basic Mode added![/b] This is a new game mode designed to help first-time players ease into the main game mode or provide an alternative for veterans looking for a more fast-paced, streamlined game mode. It includes the following features: 

[list]
[*] 15 minute rounds
[*] Smaller four-quadrant map
[*] Repair objectives only
[*] No additional roles (survivor and traitor only)
[*] Only blizzard global events
[*] No armory or truth serum lab
[*] Reduced pool of bonus objectives
[*] Reduced set of crafting recipes available
[*] Advanced items (combat stimulants, flares, etc.) no longer appear in crates
[/list]

[b]Custom Game changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Minimum player limit for starting a match is now disabled for custom matches (players will not be eligible to earn points when playing with fewer than 5 or with no traitors)
[*] Minimum/maximum traitor sliders can now be set from 0 to 7, respectively (note these settings may be ignored to ensure one survivor is always present in the match)
[*] Game duration slider can now be set as low as 15 minutes
[*] Added new settings for disabling the truth serum lab or armory
[*] Added new setting for controlling whether berry bushes should respawn
[*] Added new settings for changing the traitor airdrop timers
[*] Added new setting for controlling escape vehicle capacity
[*] Added new setting to control whether power lines leading to second objective should be visible or not
[*] Custom game settings for the current match can now be viewed from the in-game ESC menu
[*] Hovering over the custom game icon in lobby browser will now only reveal settings that are changed (to make it easier to read)
[*] Updated various parts of the main menu play tab UI to go along with the addition of basic mode:
[*] Lobby browser now allows players to select a preferred game mode, which will display its description on the left and sort all lobbies of that type to the top of the browser window
[*] The host game and quick match buttons will now display a new game mode selection screen to specify which type of lobby you want to create or join
[*] The lobby screen design has been updated to be colour-coded based on the game mode of the lobby

Project Winter [b]v1.1.9248[/b] Feature Set - Let’s Role Play! ([b]BUILD v1.1.9248_Prod[/b])

Welcome to Project Winter 1.1! We have an exciting update this month, which will include new player roles for both the survivors and traitors. These new roles will give the players special abilities unique to their role, such as healing other players or crafting certain items for a lower price. This update also includes animated emotes, a craftable backpack to increase the player’s inventory size, and a number of polish improvements such as a new hydro power station. Checkout the build notes to see all of the new content and fixes!

NEW FEATURES:

[list]
[*] [b]Expanded Player Roles Game Mode[/b]: A new gamemode is being introduced that will include expanded player roles for both the survivor and traitor classes. Each role will include a special ability that can be charged by achieving certain tasks in-game, such as opening crates and helping fix the objective.
[list]
[*] Players now have the ability to choose between a classic game mode (Traitors and Survivors only) and Expanded Roles game mode.
[*]  Expanded Roles mode is now the DEFAULT game mode. In this mode, the players spawn into the game with a small chance of being one of four new roles.
[*] Medic (Survivors): Able to craft medkits with only two herbs, and can heal other players once their ability is charged. This role has a 20% damage reduction against other players.
[*] Defector (Survivors): A survivor with the ability to open a traitor crate or airdrop once their ability bar is charged.
[*] Stitcher (Traitors): Able to craft medkits with only two herbs, and can heal other players once their ability is charged. The stitcher does not suffer a damage reduction like the medic.
[*]  Saboteur (Traitors): Energy drinks will reward traitor credits instead of increasing stats. Unlocks an ability to craft landmines with traitor credits.
[*]  A new clipboard with descriptions for all the new roles has been placed on the south facing table inside the cabin.
[*]  Hovering over your ability charge icon will pop up a short description of your ability.
[*]  When creating a new lobby, players have the ability to click a box to enable Classic mode if they do not want to play games with expanded roles.
[*] When browsing available lobbies, players can differentiate which game mode the lobby is in by looking for the “Classic” mode icon on the far left of the lobby’s info row.

[/list]
[*] [b]New Global Event[/b]: Loot crate storm! A roar of a low flying plane, thunderous crashes... you know that one of those crates might contains gear, food, and survival. But there’s a catch… check out the event in game to find out what it is!
[list]

[*] New randomized global event added to the mix.
[*] Find the crate with all the loot in the allotted amount of time.
[/list]
[*] [b]Additional Inventory Slot[/b]: Craft a fifth inventory slot from in-game resources to carry all those hearts you’re collecting! (Recipe available from the crafting table menu)
[*] [b]New Emote Animations[/b]: Characters now animate when emotes are triggered! Two brand new emotes have also been added, a pointing emote and a beckoning emote, which increases the total amount of emotes to 8.
[*] [b]New Power Station Variation[/b]: The power station has received a makeover! The hydro station will serve the same function as the power station, but with a new aesthetic. Each game will randomize between the previous power station and the new hydro station. 
[*] [b]New Falling States[/b]: When falling from a certain height, the player will now play a falling animation. For shorter falls you will be able to move immediately upon hitting the ground, for higher falls you will be briefly immobilized while a landing animation plays.
[*] [b]Better Traitor Picking[/b]: The weighting system is now based on the amount of consecutive times a player has been a survivor.
[*] [b]Discord Rich Presence[/b]: See which of your friends are playing Project Winter from their discord profile. You’ll be able to see if they’re in-game, how many players are in their match, and what their reputation badge is! 
[*] [b]Outfit Randomizer[/b]: When selecting an outfit for your character you can now select the option to randomize what your character wears.
[*] [b]Slope Speed Slow Down[/b]: Players now move slower when going uphill.
[*] [b]New Cosmetic Crate Items[/b]: 50 new in-game crate items to unlock!
[*] [b]Lobby Search Filter[/b]: Find specific lobbies easier by using the new search filter in the lobby browser.
[/list]

BALANCE CHANGES:

[*] Mass hysteria event duration has been reduced by 30%
[*] Being reported now has a bigger impact on your social rating
[*] The power station and truth serum lab now have a greater minimum distance for placement to prevent them from appearing directly beside each other

Greetings Survivors! Welcome to Project Winter: The Social Update! For this update we have mostly focused on improving quality of life aspects of existing features. Here are the new things you can expect from this update:


[b]Profile / Social Rating Page[/b]:

[b]Social Rating system[/b]: 
[list]
[*] Players now have a social rating system that displays how well they do in the game and how cooperative they are. Details on the system are:
[*] All players now have a badge next to their names that displays their social rating level. 
[*] Every Player starts with the same rating of ‘base’ positive (Bronze Badge)
[*] You social rating is improved whenever a player gives you a thumbs up at the end of every match. The max positive social level a player can reach is Gold. 
[*] Your social rating is negatively affected when a player reports you. If your social rating degrades below the base “bronze” level, your name will display an exclamation mark badge next to it.
[*] Rating inactivity will cause your social rating to reset back to base Bronze level over time.
[*] Players can report other players a maximum of 3 times per day. This helps avoid abusing the system.
[/list]
